Game Overview

Kingdom of Toilets is a two-player title where embark on a thrilling two-player adventure in Kingdom of Toilets. Navigate a pixel-art labyrinth, mastering double jumps and strategy. Collect coins, evade toxic hazards, and coordinate escapes as agile toilet robots, making every level a test of skill and teamwork. Dive into a quirky, puzzle-filled universe!
